A Prayer of Gratitude
Dear Lord, Thank You for writing our love story. Thank You for guiding us through every challenge, every tear, every prayer, and every victory. One year ago You joined our hearts as husband and wife. Today we celebrate not only our anniversary but Your faithfulness throughout this journey. Thank You for our marriage, our family, and the precious baby You entrusted to us. May our love continue to grow stronger with every year You bless us with.Amen. 🙏
